method: Equilibrium Propagation: free settle (input clamped) vs nudged settle (output nudged, strength beta); contrastive update (lr/beta)(outer_nudged - outer_free); symmetric W; tanh
recipe: settle to true fixed point (25-50 steps, NOT 12); init +-0.3; beta 0.5-1.0. The earlier naive-CHL failure (59.7%) was under-settling, not a principled wall.

xor2bit.ep: 4/4 in 8/9 configs (beta 0.1-1.0 x lr 0.01-0.1, 500 epochs, 50 settle steps)

xorNeighbor8bit.task: y = x XOR east-shift(x), 8-bit 1D bipolar, K=300 train / 200 test

verdict: Hidden-layer credit assignment without backprop WORKS (2-bit XOR solved; 8-bit 73-77% vs chance 50% and naive-CHL 59.7%). Gap to backprop (~10 pts) + bigger-H brittleness + ~100x slower (settling) remain open. Architecture consequence: ELM closed-form covers hidden layers now (instant); EP is the principled online rule (demonstrated, CPU-feasible).
